title: Senior Sales Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description Congratulations, you have taken the first step towards bagging a career-defining role. Join the team of superheroes that safeguard data wherever it goes. About Seclore: Seclore is the Data Security Intelligence company for the era of enterprise AI. Seclore helps organisations secure the data that powers how people and AI work, enabling them to adopt AI safely without losing control of sensitive information. By securing data itself and ensuring protection travels with it wherever it moves, Seclore enables trust, control, and resilience across the modern enterprise. Seclore serves more than 500 global enterprises and government organisations across over 40 countries. For more information, visit www.seclore.com . You would love our tribe: If you are a risk-taker, innovator, and fearless problem solver who loves solving challenges of data security, then this is the place for you! Role Requirement: Sales Collaboration: Work alongside the sales team to introduce Seclore’s data-centric security solutions to prospective customers. Discovery & Solution Design: Lead discovery sessions to deeply understand customer needs, then design and deliver tailored technical presentations and demos to C-level and technical audiences. Technical Expertise: Become a subject matter expert in Seclore’s platform, leveraging product capabilities to create impactful, customized solutions. Proof of Value Execution: Define use cases, success criteria, and test scenarios. Coordinate technical setup and environmental prerequisites. Guide the customer through evaluation, provide support, and ensure a successful closure. Proposal & RFP Support: Collaborate on technical content, pricing models, and implementation plans for RFPs and RFIs. Market Insight: Track security market trends, competitive products, and create internal battlecards to aid in strategic selling. Customer Advocacy: Act as the voice of the customer internally, offering feedback to Product Management and Engineering. Partner Enablement: Support ecosystem partners in developing best-fit solutions. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Support to ensure alignment during the sales cycle. The role involves 20–30% travel as part of business requirements and stakeholder engagements. Skills & Experience that we value: Have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field. Experience: 7+ years in a customer-facing Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales role at an enterprise software company, ideally in the data security domain. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Presentation: Proven experience delivering compelling product demos, technical presentations, and user training sessions. Mindset: Self-driven, collaborative, and adaptable—with a focus on closing deals and thriving in a fast-paced startup culture. Bonus Points (Preferred Skills) Experience with data-centric security technologies such as: DSPM,DLP, Data Classification, Encryption, Threat Intelligence CASB, Endpoint Security, Email Security, Cloud Security Cloud environment understanding like Azure, AWS, etc. AD and User Authentication tools and services Certifications in cybersecurity or related domains Familiarity with verticals like BFSI, Pharma, Manufacturing etc. and their compliances and regulations CRM proficiency and a structured approach to asynchronous work and documentation Let’s build the future of data security at Seclore together. Seclore has a unique opportunity for an HR Business Partner (HRBP). It acts as a consultant or Owner for Strategic HR Initiatives for the Business. The HRBP helps businesses generate value and drive Organizational outcomes by understanding business priorities and driving people initiatives.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Build partnerships and engage with leaders/managers/HODs effectively toward the design and execution of change management/Strategic initiatives.
- Effectively work with leaders for employee retention and engagement.
- Facilitate Performance Management and manage performance management lifecycle to enable consistently high performance.
- Drive performance through effective PMS systems and capability-building interventions.
- Ensure effective employee onboarding and induction to give an objective view of the organization's culture and work ethics to the new joiners.
- Be a culture shaper & ensure that our culture and values are made visible and real through various programs and initiatives.
- Facilitate the entire learning & development cycle by capturing training needs, coordinating with training specialists, conducting training, and evaluating the effectiveness of the training programs.
- Facilitate mentoring & coaching to enhance leadership capabilities to cater to business needs and meet employee expectations.
- Review and analyze business processes to identify trends across geographies and recommend solutions to improve retention and employee engagement.
- Initiating forums and mechanisms towards enhancing the employee experience, improving retention, and motivating people to achieve their fullest potential.
- Work with department heads, managers, and employees to timely address and resolve all types of employee relations issues ensuring a fair and transparent work environment.
- Provide ongoing support to the leadership team on human resources-related matters, decisions, processes, policies, and procedures.
- Work closely with People Operations to brainstorm and implement innovative people initiatives toward employee engagement.
- Capturing employee pulse to provide floor insights to the stakeholders to ensure employee satisfaction.
- Drive career levelling frameworks and define Individual Development Plans (IDPs) to support employee growth and organizational capability building.
- Create and maintain insights and dashboards for all Talent Management (TM) related processes to enable process governance and identify timely interventions. Must Have
- Ability to influence and partner with stakeholders at different levels of the organization to cater to business needs.
- Strong business and HR acumen, including strong people connections, Employee relations problem-solving skills, critical thinking, negotiation skills & stakeholder management.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Hands-on experience with HRMS platforms, preferably Darwin Box .
- Hands-on experience in compensation planning and review cycles. Good to Have
- Knowledge of AI tools applicable to Talent Management processes (e.g.,
- AI-driven assessments, engagement analytics tools). Qualification
- Master’s Degree in Human Resources Management (Preferred from top/tier 1 MBA colleges in India).
- Candidate should have a total of 5–8 years of experience in HR with at least 3 years in the Software industry. Let’s build the future of data security at Seclore together. Job Snapshot Updated Date 19/06/2026 Job ID 196 Department People Practices Location Mumbai, Maharashtra, India Experience 5

You will play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing Seclore’s core products while contributing to architectural decisions and mentoring fellow engineers. Technical Problem Solving • Research and evaluate multiple approaches for solving complex technical challenges. • Analyze customer-reported issues and provide effective resolutions. • Debug and troubleshoot application, system, and performance issues. • Drive root cause analysis and implement preventive solutions. Architecture & Design • Design reusable components and modules with a focus on maintainability and scalability. • Contribute to product architecture discussions and technical decision-making. • Ensure adherence to coding standards, security requirements, and performance benchmarks. Team Collaboration & Leadership • Manage priorities, deadlines, and deliverables effectively. • Collaborate with product, engineering, and support teams to ensure successful product delivery. • Mentor and train team members on design techniques, engineering best practices, and technologies. • Guide team members on technical approaches and solution design. Security & Platform Engineering • Develop solutions with a strong focus on security, performance, and reliability. • Work on Windows system programming and low-level platform integrations. • Contribute to secure software development practices aligned with Seclore’s security-first culture. We can see the next Entrepreneur at Seclore if you have: • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in C/C++ development on Windows, Linux, or mac OS platforms. • BE / B.Tech / MCA / PGDST or equivalent degree from a reputed institute. • Strong experience in designing software components and modules. • Experience mentoring engineers and guiding teams on technical challenges. • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. • Ability to work independently and thrive in a highly agile environment. • Passion, perseverance, curiosity, and an innovation-driven mindset. Technical Expertise • Strong experience in C/C++ development. • Experience with XML, STL, Win32 SDK, Dynamic Libraries / Shared Libraries. • Knowledge of Process Management, Multithreading, Windows Messages, ATL, and COM. • Experience with HTTP, File I/O, Memory Mapping, API Hooking, and Memory Management. • Strong understanding of Windows System Programming. • Experience debugging and troubleshooting using Sysinternals Tools, Debuggers (Win Dbg), API Monitoring, and Tracing tools. • Experience working with Microsoft Office and Outlook Object Models. • Understanding of Cryptography, Data Security, Information Security, and Security Technologies. • Experience in Cross-Platform Development. • Experience building Desktop Software Applications. GOOD TO HAVE: • Experience working in data security or cybersecurity product companies. • Exposure to secure coding and security best practices. • Understanding of enterprise software architecture and integrations. • Experience working with large-scale product deployments. • Initiative to take ownership and drive end-to-end delivery with the highest quality standards.
